request.prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background. The Mullgoth: a low, domed mound that looks like a decomposing hillock that decided to walk. The body is one single rounded dome with no distinct head, neck or snout. Long pale hair drapes over the whole dome and hangs all the way to the ground on every facing, its hem resting on the soil, hiding four short, thick legs so that only the dark feet and short glimpses of the thick legs show beneath it. The hair is patched with grey-green moss and lilac lichen growing on it like ground cover. The feet are rooty, moss-clad pads half buried in the ground and hidden under the hair, so the creature reads as walking ground cover; the legs are knobby and root-like and wrapped in moss. Black, glistening slime drips from the underside onto the ground beneath. Every facing shows the mound at the same height and width, filling the same share of the frame, from the same camera distance. Front view, seen from the front: the leading end of the mound is a heavier, slime-drenched lip with a denser moss brow above it, the hair parted around it, and the front feet are the same size as the hind feet. Side view, seen from the side: the dome in profile, hair hem on the ground, the front lip at one end and the rear curtain at the other. Rear view, seen from behind: an unbroken curtain of pale hair with a single central parted hank, the haunches rounded and the hind feet at the hem. Silhouette edges are clean: hair tips fade to transparent in pale grey-white with no coloured fringe pixels.
